title: Otori Emu — Dream Study Session?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Morinomiya Revue was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Their theatre was so big and sparkly, and their rehearsal rooms were put together just right♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then there's the Morinomiya Music Academy!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: So, during this visit, you'll all be training with the Morinomiya Music Academy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?! We get to take lessons at the Morinomiya Music Academy?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, I've heard of that school!
It's where everyone studies to become members of the Morinomiya Revue, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's right.
Several hundred apply to enroll each year, but they're competing for around thirty spots.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Only those who are accepted can apply to become members of the Morinomiya Revue. In other words, they're the best of the best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I knew that you had to enroll in their school in order to become a full member, but getting to study there is so cool.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It would've been great to learn more about singing and acting with the others!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But!
I need to learn as much as I can about how they run things!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because they're incredibly popular, and have been loved by all sorts of people for over a hundred years!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. That means I need to learn how to make it so Phoenix Wonderland is loved by everyone ten thousand years from now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, in order to do that♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'll return to their website!
And continue reading about the history of the Morinomiya Revue☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (My plan was to learn all about them before we went...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But a hundred years of history is a ton of stuff, and I couldn't get through it all in time.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm halfway through, so I've gotta do my best to read the rest today! Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but I crammed a lot of information into my head today, so I should probably start again from the beginning and... Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...? I'm starting to feel really sleepy all of a sudden... What time is it...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I brushed my teeth already.
Mr. Chef's already asleep, so I can't ask him to make something for me... Yaaawn...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like ice cream that's melting away...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then... Oh, I'll try holding my notebook while I sleep. That might help me dream about what I learned today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But does that mean I'm gonna be learning alone in my dream...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It'd be great to have Nene and the others there with me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
When did I get back to Morinomiya?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Emu. I know it's early, but you gotta wake up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What are you guys doing here?!
I brushed my teeth, was about to have my three-o'clock snack and... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What are you saying?
We're here to learn together, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We mentioned how we'd like to learn more about the operational side of things with you, because we don't have any lessons today, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?! That's perfect!
I really wanna learn with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta go, or we're gonna be late.
